Routed vehicle contact inspection

Actual Three.js rail and wheel geometry · canonical physical order · fixed 60 Hz route history
Engineering body envelopes and simplified running gear. Desktop software rendering; no production-art or device certification.

Green, blue and amber outlines are the immutable engine, coach and wagon dimensions. Small gold links show the two pivoting 1.5 mm stems and fixed 6 mm coupling gap. The middle locomotive axle follows the route with prototype lateral accommodation. The turnout displays its route rails; production blade, frog and linkage art is separate work.
